say:0:1010005001:0.text: Everyone! Go search for survivors. Leave this to me!

say:3:1010008002:2.female: Ah... General, the magister's condition, you see... She's forgotten you again...

say:4:1010008003:1.text: It's okay, Chippy. No matter how many times <style="stress"><player_name></style> forgets, I'm happy to reintroduce myself to him.
say:4:1010008003:1.male: It's okay, Chippy. No matter how many times <style="stress"><player_name></style> forgets, I'm happy to reintroduce myself to him.
say:4:1010008003:1.female: It's okay, Chippy. No matter how many times <style="stress"><player_name></style> forgets, I'm happy to reintroduce myself to her.

say:5:1010008006:1.text: I am Hogan, the former leader of the Heroic Order of the <style="highlight">Lightbearer Empire</style> and the current magistrate of <style="highlight">Holistone</style>.

say:6:1010008007:1.text: We've been friends for decades, and our friendship will never fade, no matter how muddled your memory gets.
say:6:1010008007:1.source_cn: 我们的友谊已经延续了几十年，不管你的记忆有多么混乱，它...

say:7:1010008008:1.text: But this is no time for small talk, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Look at these fire elementals.
say:7:1010008008:1.source_cn: 但现在不是寒暄的时候，<style=stress><p...
say:7:1010008008:1.male: But this is no time for small talk, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Look at these fire elementals.
say:7:1010008008:1.female: But this is no time for small talk, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Look at these fire elementals.

say:8:1010008009:1.text: They don't belong in <style="highlight">Ryeham</style>. How could they just appear out of nowhere?

choice_prompt:9:1010008009.text: They don't belong in <style="highlight">Ryeham</style>. How could they just appear out of nowhere?
choice_prompt:9:1010008009.source_cn: <style=highlight>金穗村</style>并不是它们的栖息地，它们怎么会凭空出现？

say:10:1010008010:1.text: Then, our most pressing concern is to put out the fire.
say:10:1010008010:1.source_cn: 所以我们的当务之急是灭火。

say:11:1010008013:1.text: Please give me a hand, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's put this fire out together!
say:11:1010008013:1.male: Please give me a hand, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's put this fire out together!
say:11:1010008013:1.female: Please give me a hand, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's put this fire out together!

say:13:1010008011:1.text: Seems my instincts were right... This fire was no accident.
say:13:1010008011:1.source_cn: 看来我的直觉很对……这场火灾不是一起意外。

say:14:1010008012:1.text: Hahaha... As expected of the mage who was named Merlin! You never change.
say:14:1010008012:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈……不愧是继承了梅林之名的大魔法师，真像你的作风。

say:15:1010008004:1.text: Oh, I really hope this is the last time I hear this question from you.
say:15:1010008004:1.source_cn: 唉……真希望这是我最后一次从你嘴里听到这个问题。

say:16:1010008005:1.text: But no matter how many times you lose your memory, I'm happy to reintroduce myself again to you.
say:16:1010008005:1.source_cn: 但是，无论你失忆多少次，我都愿意重新向你自我介绍。

say:0:1010008102:0.text: These opportunistic scum... I'm gonna teach you a lesson!
say:0:1010008102:0.source_cn: 这些趁火打劫的混蛋……给你们点颜色瞧瞧！

say:2:1010013001:1.text:
Valen! You're just getting here now?
Were you deep in your cups again?
say:2:1010013001:1.source_cn: 维伦！磨磨蹭蹭，现在才来！\n你是不是又一头栽进酒馆里了？

say:3:1010013002:1.text: That's not fair... I ran into a bunch of fire elementals on the way here. Those guys were really annoying.
say:3:1010013002:1.source_cn: 冤枉……我在路上遇到了一大群火元素，那些小家伙实在太烦人了。

say:4:1010013003:1.text: Anyway, looks pretty grim here... I didn't expect the fire to be this big. This is not normal, General.
say:4:1010013003:1.source_cn: 话说回来，这景象真是惨烈啊……没想到火势这么凶猛。将军...

say:7:1010013004:1.text: That's right! We think it's <style="highlight">arson</style>. The culprit is likely a mage!

say:8:1010013005:1.text: Whoa... A talking hamster. You're a familiar, aren't you?
say:8:1010013005:1.source_cn: 哇哦……穿衣服的仓鼠在说话，你是使魔吧。

say:9:1010013006:1.text:
In that case, this gentleman with the general must be a mage.
I gotta say picking a hamster as your familiar is rather... unique.
say:9:1010013006:1.source_cn: 这么说，将军身边这位<male>先生</male><f...
say:9:1010013006:1.male:
In that case, this gentleman with the general must be a mage.
I gotta say picking a hamster as your familiar is rather... unique.
say:9:1010013006:1.female:
In that case, this lady with the general must be a mage.
I gotta say picking a hamster as your familiar is rather... unique.

say:12:1010013007:1.text:
I'd normally overlook your banter, Valen.
But in front of this magister, you'd better watch your words.
say:12:1010013007:1.source_cn: 维伦，换做平时我大概会放任你。\n但是在这位大人面前，...

I'd normally overlook your banter, Valen.
But in front of this magister, you'd better watch your words.
say:12:1010013007:1.female:

But in front of this magister, you'd better watch your words.

say:13:1010013008:1.text: It's rare to command such respect from the general.
say:13:1010013008:1.source_cn: 竟能让将军如此敬重，真是罕见。

say:14:1010013009:1.text: Well, Magister, I am Valen of the Heroic Order. How would you like me to address you?

<style="stress"><player_name></style>... Hm, an interesting name.

<style="stress"><player_name></style>... Hm, an interesting name.

say:17:1010013011:1.text: Forgive my rudeness earlier. I'll be sure to make it up to you once this fire has been dealt with.
say:17:1010013011:1.source_cn: 刚才是我失礼了，等到扑灭这场麻烦的火，再好好向你道歉吧。

say:1:1010017001:1.source_cn: 醒了？你现在感觉怎么样？

choice_prompt:2:1010017001.text: You awake? How are you feeling?
choice_prompt:2:1010017001.source_cn: 醒了？你现在感觉怎么样？

say:3:1010017002:1.text: If I hadn't seen you pass out just now, I'd probably believe you.
say:3:1010017002:1.source_cn: 要不是看见你昏倒的全过程，我大概会相信这句话。

say:4:1010017005:1.text: You passed out for a while. General Hogan and his men put out the fire. Then, he returned to Holistone. He ordered me to stay here and look after you.
say:4:1010017005:1.source_cn: 你昏迷了好一阵，在这期间，霍根将军已经派人灭了火，回到...

say:5:1010017006:1.text: Before he left, the general told me to make sure that when you woke up, your memory was alright.
say:5:1010017006:1.source_cn: 将军离开前再三嘱咐，要我在你醒来后，确认你的记忆是否正常。

say:6:1010017007:1.text: What a strange request... Do you often forget things?
say:6:1010017007:1.source_cn: 真是个奇怪的要求……难道你经常失忆？

say:7:1010017008:1.text: Also, how much do you remember of what just happened?
say:7:1010017008:1.source_cn: 那么问题来了：关于刚才的事，你还记得多少？

That kid with the huge bag and the duck on his head.

say:13:1010017012:1.source_cn: 他们两个被霍根将军带回圣石镇，接受调查了。

say:14:1010017016:1.text:
Mirael's attitude toward you was unusual.
When you passed out, she was the first to get to you.

choice_prompt:16:1010017017.text: Did you know her from before?

say:20:1010017020:1.text: Chippy checked all around and didn't see any elemental beings. The village is safe now.
say:20:1010017020:1.source_cn: 满满在附近仔仔细细侦查了一圈，没看到元素生物，村子暂时安全。

say:21:1010017021:1.text: Mr. Valen told you that General Hogan already left for <style="highlight">Holistone</style>, right?
say:21:1010017021:1.source_cn: 维伦先生有没有告诉您，霍根将军已经去<style=hi...

say:22:1010017022:1.text: The general will wait for us in the village, so we should go meet him in Holistone. He seemed to have something to say to you.

say:23:1010017023:1.text: There might be enemies on the road, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll go with you.
say:23:1010017023:1.source_cn: 这一路上说不定会遇到敌人，<style=stress>...
say:23:1010017023:1.male: There might be enemies on the road, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll go with you.
say:23:1010017023:1.female: There might be enemies on the road, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll go with you.

say:24:1010017024:1.text: Although, you might not need my protection.
say:24:1010017024:1.source_cn: 虽然，你不一定需要我的保护。

say:25:1010017025:1.text: Of course! The magister is THE Mer... umm... the merriest mage that everyone loves!
say:25:1010017025:1.source_cn: 那当然了……毕竟主人可是梅——没……没有对手的魔法师！

say:25:1010017025:1.female: Of course! The magister is THE Mer... umm... the merriest mage that everyone loves!

say:27:1010017027:1.text: Anyway! Since you're feeling better, Magister, should we set off?

say:27:1010017027:1.female: Anyway! Since you're feeling better, Magister, should we set off?

choice:8:1:2.female: There was a boy with a duck.

say:34:1010017003:1.source_cn: 你用魔法打败了那个巨大的风元素，还没来得及替你鼓掌，你...

say:35:1010017004:1.text: Anyone with a heart would worry about you.
say:35:1010017004:1.source_cn: 但凡有点良心，应该都会替你担忧。

say:4:1010022003:0.text: But recently, Ryeham's been getting <style="highlight">colder</style>. It's almost snowed the past few days. We've come with the magister to investigate this <style="highlight">change in weather</style>.
say:4:1010022003:0.source_cn: 可是金穗村最近<style=highlight>越来越...
say:4:1010022003:0.male: But recently, Ryeham's been getting <style="highlight">colder</style>. It's almost snowed the past few days. We've come with the magister to investigate this <style="highlight">change in weather</style>.
say:4:1010022003:0.female: But recently, Ryeham's been getting <style="highlight">colder</style>. It's almost snowed the past few days. We've come with the magister to investigate this <style="highlight">change in weather</style>.

say:5:1010022004:0.text: My apologies, Miss Hamster, I never got your name.
say:5:1010022004:0.source_cn: 请问这位仓鼠小姐，你是……？

say:6:1010022005:0.text: Yes, we should be introduced. You are Valen. I am Hammie.
say:6:1010022005:0.source_cn: 初次见面，名为维伦的骑士，我是漫漫。

say:10:1010022009:0.text: Chippy told me that General Hogan ordered you to protect the magister.
say:10:1010022009:0.source_cn: 我从满满那里听说了，你是奉霍根将军之命来保护主人的。
say:10:1010022009:0.male: Chippy told me that General Hogan ordered you to protect the magister.
say:10:1010022009:0.female: Chippy told me that General Hogan ordered you to protect the magister.

say:11:1010022010:0.text: You must know that serving the magister is an honor, but it's not easy. I'll be observing you. I hope you'll become a competent retainer.
say:11:1010022010:0.source_cn: 要知道，侍奉我的主人，这是一项光荣且艰巨的工作，我会时...
say:11:1010022010:0.male: You must know that serving the magister is an honor, but it's not easy. I'll be observing you. I hope you'll become a competent retainer.
say:11:1010022010:0.female: You must know that serving the magister is an honor, but it's not easy. I'll be observing you. I hope you'll become a competent retainer.

say:12:1010022011:0.text: Apologies again, but I have to correct you. I'm a knight, not someone's retainer.
say:12:1010022011:0.source_cn: 很抱歉，我必须纠正一点。我是骑士，不是仆人。

say:13:1010022012:0.text: Protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> is just my current task. It's not a lifelong post.
say:13:1010022012:0.male: Protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> is just my current task. It's not a lifelong post.
say:13:1010022012:0.female: Protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> is just my current task. It's not a lifelong post.

say:14:1010022013:0.text: Unless... your magister is someone like the great Merlin, then I may consider it.
say:14:1010022013:0.source_cn: 除非……你的主人是梅林那样的魔法师，或许我会考虑考虑。
say:14:1010022013:0.male: Unless... your magister is someone like the great Merlin, then I may consider it.
say:14:1010022013:0.female: Unless... your magister is someone like the great Merlin, then I may consider it.

say:16:1010022014:0.text: Did I hear that right? Well, the magister... he is Mer...OUCH!
say:16:1010022014:0.male: Did I hear that right? Well, the magister... he is Mer...OUCH!
say:16:1010022014:0.female: Did I hear that right? Well, the magister... she is Mer...OUCH!

say:17:1010022015:0.text: Why did you just step on my foot, Hammie?!
say:17:1010022015:0.source_cn: 漫漫！你为什么要踩我的脚！

say:18:1010022016:0.text: Oh, sorry... Chippy likes to spout nonsense. Don't mind him, Mr. Valen.
say:18:1010022016:0.source_cn: 咳，真是失礼……满满喜欢胡说，还请维伦先生不要介意。

say:19:1010022017:0.text: Once you've spent some time together, you'll realize that although the magister isn't Merlin, he is just as powerful!
say:19:1010022017:0.source_cn: 只要相处一段时间你就会发现，我的主人虽然不是梅林，但<...
say:19:1010022017:0.male: Once you've spent some time together, you'll realize that although the magister isn't Merlin, he is just as powerful!
say:19:1010022017:0.female: Once you've spent some time together, you'll realize that although the magister isn't Merlin, she is just as powerful!

say:20:1010022018:0.text: You'll see that he is practically the same as Merlin, except for the different appearance and name.
say:20:1010022018:0.source_cn: 你会发现，除了长相和名字不一样，<male>他</ma...
say:20:1010022018:0.male: You'll see that he is practically the same as Merlin, except for the different appearance and name.
say:20:1010022018:0.female: You'll see that she is practically the same as Merlin, except for the different appearance and name.

say:21:1010022019:0.text: Okay... I'll just wait and see.

say:22:1010022020:0.text: We should get going. I really want to get to Holistone as soon as possible. I need a hot drink to help me warm up.
say:22:1010022020:0.source_cn: 我们快走吧，我想赶紧回圣石镇喝上一杯热饮，暖暖身子。

say:23:1010022021:0.text: Dura above... I really hope the general doesn't give me another assignment.
say:23:1010022021:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上……真希望将军别给我安排其他工作了。

say:0:1010023001:0.text: We're almost there. The general should be waiting for us.
say:0:1010023001:0.source_cn: 马上就到圣石镇了，将军应该就在前面等我们。

say:0:1010025101:0.text: This is our chance to look around Holistone. We can find General Hogan later.
say:0:1010025101:0.source_cn: 机会难得！我们先在圣石镇转转，之后再来找霍根将军吧。

say:1:1010025102:0.text: Holistone's main attraction is <style="highlight">Dura's Statue</style>. It's famous in the empire.

say:1:1010026001:0.text: Great, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you seem to have pulled yourself together. I was really worried when you passed out.
say:1:1010026001:0.male: Great, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you seem to have pulled yourself together. I was really worried when you passed out.
say:1:1010026001:0.female: Great, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you seem to have pulled yourself together. I was really worried when you passed out.

say:2:1010026002:0.text: So, how are you getting along with Valen? I hope he hasn't offended you already.
say:2:1010026002:0.source_cn: 怎么样，和维伦的相处还算融洽吗？但愿他没有冒犯你。
say:2:1010026002:0.male: So, how are you getting along with Valen? I hope he hasn't offended you already.
say:2:1010026002:0.female: So, how are you getting along with Valen? I hope he hasn't offended you already.

choice_prompt:3:1010026002.text: So, how are you getting along with Valen? I hope he hasn't offended you already.
choice_prompt:3:1010026002.source_cn: 怎么样，和维伦的相处还算融洽吗？但愿他没有冒犯你。
choice_prompt:3:1010026002.male: So, how are you getting along with Valen? I hope he hasn't offended you already.
choice_prompt:3:1010026002.female: So, how are you getting along with Valen? I hope he hasn't offended you already.

say:4:1010026003:0.text: Really? That guy's usually a handful.
say:4:1010026003:0.source_cn: 真的吗？那小子平常可不会乖乖听话。
say:4:1010026003:0.male: Really? That guy's usually a handful.
say:4:1010026003:0.female: Really? That guy's usually a handful.

say:6:1010026006:0.text: That's not fair, General... These two little hamsters were watching my every move. I didn't slack off at all.
say:6:1010026006:0.source_cn: 冤枉啊将军……这两只小仓鼠每分每秒盯着我，我一点儿也不...

say:9:1010026007:0.text: Well, considering you helped us fight all the way here, I'll score your performance on the magister's behalf.
say:9:1010026007:0.source_cn: 好吧，看在你一路战斗的份上，我可以替主人给你的表现打个分。
say:9:1010026007:0.male: Well, considering you helped us fight all the way here, I'll score your performance on the magister's behalf.
say:9:1010026007:0.female: Well, considering you helped us fight all the way here, I'll score your performance on the magister's behalf.

say:10:1010026008:0.text: 80 out of 100. Keep up the good work, Mr. Valen.
say:10:1010026008:0.source_cn: 80分。还请你继续努力，维伦先生。

say:11:1010026009:0.text: Yes, of course... thanks for your encouragement, Hammie.
say:11:1010026009:0.source_cn: 是是……谢谢您的称赞，仓鼠小姐。

say:14:1010026010:0.text: Let me say this again, Valen. <style="stress"><player_name></style> was sent by me specifically to look into the changing weather.
say:14:1010026010:0.male: Let me say this again, Valen. <style="stress"><player_name></style> was sent by me specifically to look into the changing weather.
say:14:1010026010:0.female: Let me say this again, Valen. <style="stress"><player_name></style> was sent by me specifically to look into the changing weather.

say:15:1010026011:0.text: To ensure success, you must spare no effort in assisting <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Furthermore...
say:15:1010026011:0.source_cn: 为了保证调查顺利，你必须尽全力辅佐<style=str...
say:15:1010026011:0.male: To ensure success, you must spare no effort in assisting <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Furthermore...
say:15:1010026011:0.female: To ensure success, you must spare no effort in assisting <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Furthermore...

say:17:1010026013:0.source_cn: 将军，您这番话我已经倒背如流了。

say:18:1010026014:0.text: *Sigh*... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valen is my most trusted knight, both in strength and in character.
say:18:1010026014:0.male: *Sigh*... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valen is my most trusted knight, both in strength and in character.
say:18:1010026014:0.female: *Sigh*... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valen is my most trusted knight, both in strength and in character.

say:19:1010026015:0.text: His only shortcoming... is probably his big mouth.
say:19:1010026015:0.source_cn: 要说他唯一的缺点……大概是长了嘴。
say:19:1010026015:0.male: His only shortcoming... is probably his big mouth.
say:19:1010026015:0.female: His only shortcoming... is probably his big mouth.

say:20:1010026016:0.text: Anyway, please teach this young man a thing or two during your time together. You can be as strict as you need to be.
say:20:1010026016:0.source_cn: 总之，这段时间还请你多多教导这小子，严厉些也没问题。
say:20:1010026016:0.male: Anyway, please teach this young man a thing or two during your time together. You can be as strict as you need to be.
say:20:1010026016:0.female: Anyway, please teach this young man a thing or two during your time together. You can be as strict as you need to be.

say:21:1010026017:0.text:
Stop teasing me, General. We should get down to business.
The fire at Ryeham was clearly arson.
say:21:1010026017:0.source_cn: 别再调侃我了，先说正事吧将军。\n金穗村那场火灾，很明...

say:23:1010026018:0.text: Yes, the young master of the <style="highlight">Mithril Consortium</style> identified the culprit as the Scarlet Sorceress. Rowan believes that she was the one who summoned those fire elementals.

say:24:1010026019:0.text: The Scarlet Sorceress, however, denies it all.
say:24:1010026019:0.source_cn: 然而，灰烬魔女否认了这一切。

say:25:1010026020:0.text: I questioned the Scarlet Sorceress before you arrived, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I asked her what her reasons were for coming to Ryeham, but she didn't say a word.
say:25:1010026020:0.male: I questioned the Scarlet Sorceress before you arrived, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I asked her what her reasons were for coming to Ryeham, but she didn't say a word.
say:25:1010026020:0.female: I questioned the Scarlet Sorceress before you arrived, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I asked her what her reasons were for coming to Ryeham, but she didn't say a word.

say:26:1010026021:0.text: What about you? Do you think the Scarlet Sorceress is the culprit?
say:26:1010026021:0.source_cn: 你怎么看？你认为灰烬魔女是凶手吗？
say:26:1010026021:0.male: What about you? Do you think the Scarlet Sorceress is the culprit?
say:26:1010026021:0.female: What about you? Do you think the Scarlet Sorceress is the culprit?

choice_prompt:27:1010026021.text: What about you? Do you think the Scarlet Sorceress is the culprit?
choice_prompt:27:1010026021.source_cn: 你怎么看？你认为灰烬魔女是凶手吗？
choice_prompt:27:1010026021.male: What about you? Do you think the Scarlet Sorceress is the culprit?
choice_prompt:27:1010026021.female: What about you? Do you think the Scarlet Sorceress is the culprit?

say:28:1010026022:0.text: As it happens, the Scarlet Sorceress did say something. Just one thing, but it made me think.
say:28:1010026022:0.source_cn: 其实，灰烬魔女说了一句话，唯一的一句。这句话让我思考了很久。
say:28:1010026022:0.male: As it happens, the Scarlet Sorceress did say something. Just one thing, but it made me think.
say:28:1010026022:0.female: As it happens, the Scarlet Sorceress did say something. Just one thing, but it made me think.

say:29:1010026023:0.text: She said that you'd exonerate her.
say:29:1010026023:0.male: She said that you'd exonerate her.
say:29:1010026023:0.female: She said that you'd exonerate her.

say:30:1010026024:0.text: She seemed convinced that you would find the real culprit of the fire.
say:30:1010026024:0.source_cn: 她似乎坚信你能查出火灾的真相。
say:30:1010026024:0.male: She seemed convinced that you would find the real culprit of the fire.
say:30:1010026024:0.female: She seemed convinced that you would find the real culprit of the fire.

say:31:1010026028:0.text: You and her... I don't mean to pry, but is she an acquaintance of yours?
say:31:1010026028:0.source_cn: 你和她……我必须得问一句，她是你的熟人吗？
say:31:1010026028:0.male: You and her... I don't mean to pry, but is she an acquaintance of yours?
say:31:1010026028:0.female: You and her... I don't mean to pry, but is she an acquaintance of yours?

choice_prompt:32:1010026028.text: You and her... I don't mean to pry, but is she an acquaintance of yours?
choice_prompt:32:1010026028.source_cn: 你和她……我必须得问一句，她是你的熟人吗？
choice_prompt:32:1010026028.male: You and her... I don't mean to pry, but is she an acquaintance of yours?
choice_prompt:32:1010026028.female: You and her... I don't mean to pry, but is she an acquaintance of yours?

say:33:1010026029:0.text: True... You have lost your memory. Some things you might not be able to recall.
say:33:1010026029:0.source_cn: 唉……确实，你失去了记忆，就算曾经见过，可能也回忆不起来。
say:33:1010026029:0.male: True... You have lost your memory. Some things you might not be able to recall.
say:33:1010026029:0.female: True... You have lost your memory. Some things you might not be able to recall.

say:34:1010026030:0.text: Don't worry. We'll get to the bottom of all of this in our investigation.
say:34:1010026030:0.source_cn: 不必担心，无论真相如何，我们都会在接下来的问询中调查清楚。
say:34:1010026030:0.male: Don't worry. We'll get to the bottom of all of this in our investigation.
say:34:1010026030:0.female: Don't worry. We'll get to the bottom of all of this in our investigation.

say:35:1010026031:0.text: Oh, right. This is your first time in Holistone, isn't it?
say:35:1010026031:0.source_cn: 哦对了，这是你第一次来到圣石镇吧？
say:35:1010026031:0.male: Oh, right. This is your first time in Holistone, isn't it?
say:35:1010026031:0.female: Oh, right. This is your first time in Holistone, isn't it?

say:36:1010026032:0.text: Before troubling yourself with the investigation, you might as well take a tour around the village. I suspect you'll like it here.
say:36:1010026032:0.source_cn: 在繁忙的调查打扰你之前，你不妨先逛一逛这座小镇。我想，...
say:36:1010026032:0.male: Before troubling yourself with the investigation, you might as well take a tour around the village. I suspect you'll like it here.
say:36:1010026032:0.female: Before troubling yourself with the investigation, you might as well take a tour around the village. I suspect you'll like it here.

say:37:1010026033:0.text: Go have a look around, then come find me. I'll be waiting for you here.
say:37:1010026033:0.source_cn: 等你转上一圈，再回来找我吧，我就在这里等你。
say:37:1010026033:0.male: Go have a look around, then come find me. I'll be waiting for you here.
say:37:1010026033:0.female: Go have a look around, then come find me. I'll be waiting for you here.

choice:32:0:1.text: Hard to say. I don't remember.
choice:32:0:1.male: Hard to say. I don't remember.
choice:32:0:1.female: Hard to say. I don't remember.

say:39:1010026025:0.text: Not that I doubt your judgment, but until the truth is uncovered, I can't let her go.
say:39:1010026025:0.source_cn: 我不怀疑你的判断，但是，在查清真相前，我还不能放她离开。
say:39:1010026025:0.male: Not that I doubt your judgment, but until the truth is uncovered, I can't let her go.
say:39:1010026025:0.female: Not that I doubt your judgment, but until the truth is uncovered, I can't let her go.

say:40:1010026026:0.text: There's another matter I'm concerned about. The Scarlet Sorceress said that you'd exonerate her.
say:40:1010026026:0.source_cn: 还有一件事让我很在意，灰烬魔女说，你会还她清白。
say:40:1010026026:0.male: There's another matter I'm concerned about. The Scarlet Sorceress said that you'd exonerate her.
say:40:1010026026:0.female: There's another matter I'm concerned about. The Scarlet Sorceress said that you'd exonerate her.

say:41:1010026027:0.text: She seemed convinced that you would find the real culprit of the fire.
say:41:1010026027:0.source_cn: 她似乎坚信你能查出火灾的真相。
say:41:1010026027:0.male: She seemed convinced that you would find the real culprit of the fire.
say:41:1010026027:0.female: She seemed convinced that you would find the real culprit of the fire.

say:42:1010026004:0.text: ... I guess it didn't go so well.
say:42:1010026004:0.male: ... I guess it didn't go so well.
say:42:1010026004:0.female: ... I guess it didn't go so well.

say:43:1010026005:0.text: Valen! I told you to heed <style="stress"><player_name>'s</style> orders as if they were my own!
say:43:1010026005:0.male: Valen! I told you to heed <style="stress"><player_name>'s</style> orders as if they were my own!
say:43:1010026005:0.female: Valen! I told you to heed <style="stress"><player_name>'s</style> orders as if they were my own!

subtitle:1:1010025201:.text: Memories devoured by the long night now return.
subtitle:1:1010025201:.source_cn: 被长夜吞噬的记忆，如今归还于你
subtitle:1:1010025201:.male: Memories devoured by the long night now return.
subtitle:1:1010025201:.female: Memories devoured by the long night now return.

subtitle:1:1010025202:.text: The echo that remains here is the last of my light.
subtitle:1:1010025202:.source_cn: 这声残留于此的回响，是我最后的余晖了
subtitle:1:1010025202:.male: The echo that remains here is the last of my light.
subtitle:1:1010025202:.female: The echo that remains here is the last of my light.

subtitle:1:1010025204:.source_cn: 务必，务必回想起你的使命……

cinematic_summary:1.text: Hogan and the Lightbearer troops are surrounded by fire elementals. They're in trouble, and you know it.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 霍根和耀光士兵被火元素团团包围，陷入危境。

subtitle:1:1011083001:.text: General Hogan! The water isn't working!
subtitle:1:1011083001:.source_cn: 霍根将军，水……水不起作用！

subtitle:1:1011083002:.text: Use sand! Get these fires under control!
subtitle:1:1011083002:.source_cn: 那就泼沙！先扑灭周围的火焰！

cinematic_summary:1.text: The number of bandits is far greater than expected. You are outnumbered. Just then, Valen falls from the sky to lend you some assistance.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 强盗的数量远远超出预料，你们寡不敌众。就在这时，维伦从天而降。

cinematic_summary:1.text: Suddenly, strong winds storm into the center of the fiery scene. A huge wind elemental appears!
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 火灾中心突然刮起了阵阵狂风，一个巨大的风元素随之出现！

cinematic_summary:1.text: The wind elemental is overwhelming and incredibly powerful. In desperation, you summon a hidden well of magic to defeat it! But your magic is overdrawn, and you faint...
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 巨大的风元素极为可怕，情急之下，作为“梅林”的你召唤出了魔法阵！但随着魔力耗尽，你也晕了过去……

cinematic_summary:1.text: In order to inform Dolly that you are safe, you and Chippy head back to the Mystical House. Clad in her mage's robes, Hammie leaps to give you a warm embrace.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 你和满满回到神秘屋向多莉报平安，穿着魔法师装束的漫漫用热情的拥抱迎接了你。

subtitle:1:1011086001:.text: Dolly! I've brought back the magister.
subtitle:1:1011086001:.male: Dolly! I've brought back the magister.
subtitle:1:1011086001:.female: Dolly! I've brought back the magister.

subtitle:1:1011086002:.source_cn: 可算回来了！我们担心了一宿——

say:8:1010014101:0.text: You seem more interested in who started the fire than in putting it out.
say:8:1010014101:0.source_cn: 比起灭火，你们对纵火者是谁更感兴趣，对吗？

say:9:1010014102:0.text: I saw you casting a spell with my own eyes!
say:9:1010014102:0.source_cn: 纵火犯，我亲眼看到你在施法！

say:10:1010014103:0.text: It's not that easy to quench a greedy fire, my dear. I'm just trying to help.
say:10:1010014103:0.source_cn: 让一团贪婪燃烧的火停下来可没那么容易，亲爱的，我只是在...

say:11:1010014104:0.text:
The Scarlet Sorceress is as beautiful as her fire is dangerous.
That's what the rumors say...
say:11:1010014104:0.source_cn: 灰烬魔女有多美丽，她的火焰就有多危险……\n真见鬼，果...

say:12:1010014105:0.text:
Dangerous? You're quite right.
If this were my fire, you'd all be ashes by now...
say:12:1010014105:0.source_cn: 危险？你说的没错。\n如果这是我的火焰，你、你们，早是...

say:16:1010014106:0.text: So she's the Scarlet Sorceress! Chippy has heard of her...
say:16:1010014106:0.source_cn: 原来她就是灰烬魔女。主人，满满听过她的名号。
say:16:1010014106:0.male: So she's the Scarlet Sorceress! Chippy has heard of her...
say:16:1010014106:0.female: So she's the Scarlet Sorceress! Chippy has heard of her...

say:21:1010014109:0.text:
Hm?!

say:24:1010014111:0.text: ... Never mind. You made me think of someone.

say:25:1010014112:0.text: The divination was right. This night was awful. I shouldn't have gone out.
say:25:1010014112:0.source_cn: 占卜的结果一点也没错，这是个多灾多难的夜晚，我不该出门。

say:26:1010014113:0.text: I'd appreciate not being disturbed any further. I'm leaving.
say:26:1010014113:0.source_cn: 可以的话，还请各位别再叨扰我，我想离开了。

say:29:1010014114:0.text: You're not going anywhere, Scarlet Sorceress! All my wares are gone! I demand compensation!
say:29:1010014114:0.source_cn: 灰烬魔女，你不能走！我的货物全都被烧毁了，我需要补偿！

say:30:1010014115:0.text: Don't push your luck, young man. I'm not known for my patience.
say:30:1010014115:0.source_cn: 可不要得寸进尺哦，小弟弟，我不是一个很有耐心的人。

say:31:1010014116:0.text: Don't you dare try to get away with this! I'll make sure you're held responsible!
say:31:1010014116:0.source_cn: 你别想逃脱罪责，我一定会追究到底！

say:32:1010014117:0.source_cn: 嘘……你先安静点。\n这周围的情况似乎不太对劲。

say:33:1010014118:0.text: The wind... It's suddenly so loud.

narration:36:1010023:0.text: You find yourselves at the heart of the fire, witnessing a heated argument between the villagers and a red-haired woman.
narration:36:1010023:0.source_cn: 你们来到火灾中心，看见村民们正在和一位红发魔女争执。
